grid_note: Use deposited 2 ppd coordinates; conversion from paper 3 ppd to deposited 2 ppd undocumented in retrieved notes. Do not imply 3 ppd data were extracted.
metadata_dimension_note: Notes lists 720x360; actual ASCII matrix is360 latitude rows x720 longitude columns, independently resolved by coordinate-file lengths.
ti_unit_note: Physical SI J m^-2 K^-1 s^-1/2 from paper; Notes renders m^2 (unit typography not used to redefine TI).
limits: Two-layer thermal model assumes ice as the lower material; no unique material separation or independent local ice truth.
Lookup depths discrete, raw decimals not measurement precision.
Cannot distinguish massive from pore ice; local fraction remains unknown.
Published MCS native support ~7 km; deposited cell ~30x16 km. No sub-cell variability resolved.
MCS/THEMIS overlap other thermal evidence; no independent-truth count.
